decisions.reason: The compact modular trommel is an upgraded, renamed model with an established user base in Doppstadt's core mobile screening line, so it costs little to keep and still has upside.
The AK flail shredder series is a core mobile range that was updated to EU Stage V engines, which signals continued commitment and value rather than a resolved, failed option.

The mobile high-speed grinder fits the firm's mobile focus and was promoted to its own page in 2019, but it overlaps with other grinders already dropped, so its uncertainty is not fully resolved and it is kept for now.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder ties up costly plant-engineering resources outside the firm's mobile core, and a sister stationary shredder has already been withdrawn, so after restructuring the resources are better redirected.
